title: pigea vernonii subsp. scabra
intro: Pigea vernonii subsp. scabra, commonly known as Rough-leaved Pigea or Vernonia scabra, is a species of flowering plant in the daisy and sunflower family. This plant has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, including treating fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The health benefits of Pigea vernonii subsp. scabra are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, sesquiterpenes, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as reducing inflammation, protecting against oxidative stress, and exhibiting antimicrobial activity.
